text: Inattention [Lat. inattentio ]: Ger. Unaufmerksamkeit ; Fr. inattention ; Ital. disattenzione . A relative term denoting more or less absence of attention to a particular object when attention is normally possible. It includes the more restricted terms ABSTRACTION, DISTRACTION, and ABSENT-MINDEDNESS. ( J.M.B. , G.F.S. )
